what: When a photo’s top edge reaches the bottom of the screen, a face clipped from the bottom edge upward opens over 1s power4.inOut (clip-path polygon), and the dark veil covering it slides up .35s later on the same curve — the veil lifts one beat after the photo, so the dark band seems to sweep upward

options.delay: Time before the curtain lifts late (s), default .35
options.veil-dur: Duration of the curtain fading out (seconds), default same as dur
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (If present) dark overlay on the photo — direct child just below. Color is --kf-ink-soft
options.--fx-veil: Mask color (via style), default --kf-ink-soft — one brand uses the accent navy

note: The original is once, so once opened it never reverses. The scrim is hidden when fully cleared (the original removes it)

from.where: index.html Use Cases ten photos .clip-reveal-item — original common.js initClipRevealAnimation (start top bottom, once, 1s power4.inOut, curtain #333 bottom 0→100% delayed .35s)
shared.css .fade-in·.fade-in-lines (text·photo·title line by line — original clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0)→0 .6s CustomEase dsk, once at the 75% line of the viewport, no mask)

shared.css .slide-up (facility · people photo cells) · .tf-kv__img (subpage header photo) · index.css hero photo — original style.css .slide-up::before navy panel clip-path inset(100% 0 0)→0 in 1.2s cubic-bezier(.54,.04,0,1.01), the photo follows .8s later on the same curve · once at rootMargin -40px. The navy panel rises first and the photo is revealed above it from the bottom, matching this part’s look of a curtain lifting from the bottom
